headline: Approved minutes, motor vehicle excise abatements, and statutory exemption applications
summary: The Board of Assessors approved minutes from a prior meeting, motor vehicle excise tax abatements, and statutory exemption applications under Clauses 17E, 22, 22E, 41C, and a Senior Volunteer application. The board also noted FY27 certification work was nearly complete, with no new or old business.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the September 15, 2026 meeting.
Approved motor vehicle excise abatements for the week of September 07 to September 11.
Approved statutory exemption applications: Clause 17E (5 applications), Clause 22 (2 applications), Clause 22E (1 application), Clause 41C (2 applications), and 1 Senior Volunteer application.

MINUTES  
  
THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF ASSESSORS   
LOWELL MA September 24, 2026
  
A meeting of the Board of Assessors took place on September 22, 2026, at 9:30 AM in Room 36 
at Lowell City Hall:  
In attendance: Chief Assessor; E. Brideau, Assessor; A. Lombardo
1. Review of minutes from September 15, 2026 meetings – A. Lombardo made a motion to
approve the minutes, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.
2. Applications for MOTOR VEHICLE EXCISE TAX ABATEMENTS (supporting         
 documentation attached to each application)  
  Motor Vehicle Excise Abatements
o Week of September 07 to September 11 – Approved by signatures
o MVE Abatements for denial – None
3. Statutory Exemptions – Clause 17E: 5 applications, Clause 22: 2 applications, Clause 22E:
1 application, Clause 41C: 2 applications, and 1 Senior Volunteer application – A. Lombardo 
made a motion to approve these applications, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.
4. FY27 Certification – the public disclosure was wrapped up last Friday and all the 
inspections are done. The department will submit final data to the state this week.
5. New Business – None
6. Old Business – None
Motion to adjourn at 9:40 AM A. Lombardo, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.
Respectfully submitted,
Chornai Pech
Administrative Assistant
